description: Python scaffold for SGLang inference — src/ package with OpenAI-compatible client, pyproject.toml with type-checker config, and Makefile targets for install / typecheck / run.

buildHints.whenToUse: This layer supplies the Python project wrapper for the SGLang family — pyproject.toml metadata, a type-checker baseline, and a Makefile so developers can run common tasks without looking up flags.
firstSteps: pip install -r requirements.txt          # install client deps
make typecheck                            # pyright src/ — should be clean
cp .env.example .env && make up          # start the Docker inference server
make client                               # python -m src.client (server must be running)
gotchas: pyproject.toml sets typeCheckingMode=basic; tighten to strict only after adding py.typed and full annotations throughout src/.
The Makefile uses hard tabs — editors that silently convert to spaces will break make. Most editors detect Makefile type and preserve tabs.
`pip install -e '.[dev]'` requires pyproject.toml to be present (supplied by this layer); running it before layer application will fail.
pyright is a dev-only dep; the runtime server has no Python typechecker dependency — requirements.txt stays lean.
architectureNotes: src/__init__.py makes src/ a proper package so `python -m src.client` resolves without a separate __main__.py.
pyproject.toml is the single source of truth for Python version, project name, and dev-tool configuration — requirements.txt is kept as a flat pip-installable subset for Docker and CI.
